text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Thanks...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Hayahide was really fast.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And so intense. I couldn't keep up with
her at all
in the final sprint...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
B-but, hey—my feelings are just as
strong!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to work even harder to
make sure my
races are as awesome as
they can possibly be!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I believe that's what you were saying
before the
race as well.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide! Your sprint was awesome! The

audience cheered so loud!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Let's always be rivals and keep running
the best—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm afraid I can't see you as a
rival.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Taishin would probably say the same.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Wh-wha... But... hold on a sec!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Why?! We've always run together! We
had such a
good competition at the
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
True. At the Derby we most definitely
were each
other's rivals.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: But... not now.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Not now? I ran such a good race today!
Just like
at the Derby...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
No, Ticket—it wasn't the same.
Something was
very different.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And if you can't even recognize that
fact... then
you truly aren't my rival
anymore.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
When I set foot on the track, I'm not just
trying to
put on a "great race" for the
audience.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Why don't you think good and long
about what
you're really racing for?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Wait... Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm... not her rival anymore? And what's
she mean,
"think about why I race"?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I just... I want to run great races with my
rivals,
and make the audience feel
excited.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Is that... wrong?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
As Уиннинг Тикит mutters to herself, I
can see
her shoulders trembling a little.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
